id./param/scenario/cs/b_030_cs_090.pack|cs_: "Well, well. Another poor wandering soul has drifted to the end of the world.
"So young, too. To fall to the netherworld at this age... there are truly no gods or buddhas.
"You look dazed. Do you know the fate that awaits you?
"Oh, you know that much at your age! How amazing! A prodigy of the century! I must return and tell everyone!
"...As if I'd fall for that lie. Putting on airs even in the afterlife. What a show-off.
"Ah, pitiful. You're dead, and you don't even know the suffering to come.
"Oh well. Let me teach an ignorant child a little about the netherworld.
"Even you can see there is nothing here. This is a world of nothingness.
"Normally souls drawn here head to Yggdrasil to be reborn as new life.
"But with the Tree lost to Mordegon, the netherworld is a total void. The souls have nowhere to go, forever.
"...So your soul will soon vanish in this nothingness.
"The cycle of life through Yggdrasil is cut, and all life is fated to vanish. As long as Mordegon lives, that cannot change.
"I know it's frustrating, but give up. Nothing can be done.
"Mordegon holds the Heart of Yggdrasil, the source of all life. Do you think anyone can beat him? No one can.
"...Yet they say there are people resisting such a Mordegon.
"Truly, they never know when to give up."
